scoresOnRequiresThisOpted: Scores on requires this opted-in Keeper to be live and unpaused. Reading the ledger does not opt you in.
scoresNeedYourVerifiedTwitch: Scores need your verified Twitch login. No public score was created.
thePublicScoreRegisterIs: The public score register is full. Your claims still work; no score was created.
publicScoresOffYourScore: Public scores off. Your score name, participation count and links have been erased.
onlyThisBroadcasterCanChange: Only this broadcaster can change or read their Seeker choice.
theAuthorisedKeeperSeekerPilot: The authorised Keeper Seeker pilot is off.
youHoldTheRelicSeeker: You hold the relic. Seeker queue off; pass it on before joining again.
seekerQueueOnYourConfigured: Seeker queue on. Your configured channel may be suggested while live and eligible. !seek off to leave.
seekerQueueOffTypeSeek: Seeker queue off. Type !seek to rejoin.
theCurrentRelicHolderIs: The current relic holder is not recorded.
thatVoteWasNotCounted: That vote was not counted. Check the ritual, chat role and deadline.
yourRetainedMarksSharedLinks: Your retained marks, shared links and public scores were erased. Stream quota and cooldown are not refunded.
markHistoryLinkNotQueued: Mark-history link not queued. Use your own verified login and wait one minute between requests. Shared links are public to anyone who receives them.
onlyThisBroadcasterOrAn: Only this broadcaster or an authorized moderator can use that command.
nothingIsRetainedToVeto: Nothing is retained to veto in this channel. Moderators can remove the latest approved or pending mark; veto never refunds the five-mark allowance or waiting time.
vetoUnavailableAnEligibleRetained: Veto unavailable: an eligible retained mark and authorized same-channel moderator are required.
waitingForModeratorApprovalYour: Waiting for moderator approval. Your mark is private and is not visible on the relic. Moderators can use !relic pending.
marksAreOpenOnlyWhile: Marks are open only while this channel is live, unpaused and holding the relic. No mark was added.
noMarkWasAddedUse: No mark was added. Use one allowed word or emoji, wait 30 seconds between marks, and use at most five marks per stream. Private review text is never public.
markRequestCheckedUnderQuota: Mark request checked under quota and cooldown. Clean valid marks become public automatically; held marks stay private until moderator approval.
markRequestProcessedUnderThe: Mark request processed under the stream quota and cooldown. Only moderator-approved marks become public.
sendOffRequestCheckedThe: Send Off request checked. The Keeper uses private control to process an eligible queued request; never repeat an unknown dispatch.
keeperCommandCheckedRefreshYour: Keeper command checked. Refresh your private control for the authoritative result; role and stream safety rules still apply.
retainedCompletedArchiveOnlyInitial: Retained completed archive only. Initial home hold start is unknown; historical raider participation is not available. Raider counts start after explicit score opt-in, never retroactively.
scoresAreOffForYou: Scores are off for you. !relic scores on to join; off to leave.
arrival: The relic has arrived! Receiving chat: type !accept. Sending chat: type !offer. Both chats claim it before the local timer ends.
help: Raid Relic: !mark word leaves a rune for review; !offer sends, !accept welcomes. !where finds the Keeper; !seek is the broadcaster’s Seeker choice. !relic mymarks, top, badges, scores, scores on/off, forgetme. Moderators: !relic veto. Keeper setup and Send Off stay in private controls.
cooldown: Please wait ten seconds before repeating that command.
noSend: No Send Off is active yet. The Keeper starts one in private control; after the raid arrives, sending chat uses !offer and receiving chat uses !accept.
earlyOffer: Raid accepted. Wait for it to land, then send !offer again. This early offer was not saved.
keeperSetup: Seeker queue off. Opt in as a Keeper first, then !seek to join; !seek off to leave.
closedClaim: The binding window has closed… The relic stays with its Keeper. Begin a new Send Off to try again.
reviewInstructions: Moderators: !relic approve last or !relic reject last. Only the latest eligible pending mark is selected; no text is shared here.
reviewApproved: Approved the latest eligible pending mark in this active stream.
reviewRejected: Rejected the latest eligible pending mark in this active stream. Quota and cooldown are not refunded.
reviewEmpty: No eligible pending mark in this active stream. Approved and historical marks are unchanged.
reviewUnknownLogin: No valid signed mention target was supplied. No block was made; use a structured mention or an independently verified immutable user ID with !relic block ID.
reviewBlocked: Blocked the verified mentioned user from this channel’s retained marks. Twitch permissions are unchanged; quota and cooldown are not refunded.
